title: A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models
abstractSummary: Interprets JEPA pretraining as action-conditioned spectral graph learning and relates representation error to downstream planning regret. Finite-sample analysis identifies a latent-dimension tradeoff. A multi-depth representation extension is motivated by the theory and tested on planning tasks with difficult or unpredictable observations.
abstractSummaryZh: 将JEPA预训练解释为动作条件谱图学习，并推导表示误差与规划遗憾之间的有限样本关系。分析揭示潜在维度的权衡，并据此提出多深度表示，在困难或不可预测观测下测试规划效果。
tags: JEPA; Theory; Generalization; Planning
relevanceNote: Theory explicitly connects world-model pretraining to downstream planning quality.
relevanceNoteZh: 将世界模型预训练误差与下游规划质量建立理论联系。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: A World Model Can Predict the Future Without Knowing Its Cause: Interventional Evaluation of Action-Conditioned World Models
abstractSummary: Shows why individual-rollout scores cannot establish whether changed actions produce correct changes in outcomes. Paired interventions in Atari and control simulators directly measure causal response across world-model architectures. Plausible predictions can coexist with poor action-effect alignment; the relationship to planning usefulness remains inconclusive.
abstractSummaryZh: 说明单条未来轨迹的质量评分无法确定动作变化是否引起正确的结果变化。通过Atari和控制模拟器中的成对干预评测多种世界模型，发现逼真的预测仍可能缺乏正确的动作效果；与规划收益的关系尚无定论。
tags: Causal evaluation; Action fidelity; Benchmark
relevanceNote: Directly measures the causal action-response behavior that makes world models useful for planning.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接测量规划所需的动作—结果因果响应。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: ActionRoPE: Action as Coordinates for Spatially Consistent Control in Planar-Camera Game World Models
abstractSummary: ActionRoPE translates player-driven camera displacement into rotary positions in world coordinates, preserving positional addresses across frames. A coordinate-dependent noise schedule treats previously observed and newly exposed regions differently. Evaluations measure movement obedience and scene drift in planar-camera game worlds across model sizes.
tags: Action conditioning; world coordinates; game world models; scene consistency
relevanceNote: Encodes action effects geometrically to maintain a consistent interactive game world.
relevanceNoteZh: 将动作效果编码为世界坐标变化，提升交互式游戏世界的控制与空间一致性。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
abstractSummary: Learns variable-specific latent states and an action-conditioned transition from factual trajectories, then rolls the transition forward under alternative action plans. A simulator-grounded suite spanning energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory compares forecasting, intervention fidelity, and planning, finding that rankings differ across these criteria.
abstractSummaryZh: 从事实轨迹学习变量级潜在状态和动作条件转移，并在候选动作计划下展开未来。能源、交通、温室和库存模拟实验分别检验预测、干预保真度与规划，发现这些指标给出的模型排名并不一致。
tags: Time series; Action conditioning; Interventions; Planning
relevanceNote: Explicit action-conditioned world model with counterfactual rollout and closed-loop planning evaluation.
relevanceNoteZh: 显式的动作条件世界模型，同时评测反事实展开与闭环规划。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Adaptive Small Worlds: Query-Sufficient Compilation for Efficient World-Model Planning
abstractSummary: Compiles an existing world model into a query-specific reduced model containing relevant state factors, action effects, and rewards. Dependencies restore missing prerequisites, and initial plan steps are checked in the original model. Analysis bounds reward loss, while symbolic benchmarks evaluate success under transition budgets.
abstractSummaryZh: 将现有世界模型简化为包含当前查询相关状态因素、动作效果和奖励的模型。利用依赖关系补足前提，并在原模型中检查计划的初始步骤；理论分析奖励损失，符号环境实验检验有限转移预算下的效果。
tags: Planning; State abstraction; Theory
relevanceNote: Studies task-specific executable abstraction of a world model for efficient planning.
relevanceNoteZh: 研究如何将完整世界模型编译为适合当前任务的可执行小模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Adversarially Robust Multi-Agent RL via Test-Time Imagination
abstractSummary: MATRIX uses a diffusion world model for imagined policy training and robust execution. Locally conditioned predictions let decentralized agents counter corrupted observations without requiring global information at deployment.
abstractSummaryZh: MATRIX 使用扩散世界模型生成策略训练经验，并通过只依赖局部信息的观测预测，在分散执行时缓解对抗性观测干扰。
tags: Model-based RL; Multi-agent; Diffusion; Robustness
relevanceNote: Uses world-model imagination both to learn policies and to defend deployed agents.
relevanceNoteZh: 利用世界模型想象同时支持多智能体策略学习与部署稳健性。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: AdvSim2Real: Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
abstractSummary: Trains a web agent inside a frozen web simulator while jointly evolving task difficulty and an adaptive injection adversary. The reported improvements include higher completion under unseen attacks and capability transfer to a real browser, demonstrating a practical use of simulated interaction for robust agent training.
abstractSummaryZh: 在冻结的网页模拟器中联合演化任务难度、提示注入攻击者和网页智能体。实验报告对未见攻击的鲁棒性提高，并将部分能力收益迁移到真实浏览器，展示模拟交互在智能体训练中的用途。
tags: Web world models; Agent training; Robustness
relevanceNote: Uses a learned web world model as the training environment for agent–adversary interaction.
relevanceNoteZh: 以学习到的网页世界模型作为智能体与对抗者交互的训练环境。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
abstractSummary: Models how reasoning and actions affect task progress instead of reconstructing tool responses. Action assessment and state revision remove unsupported or stale reasoning from agent continuations. Training across search, terminal, and software tasks improves action judgments and downstream agent results, including through trajectory-based fine-tuning.
abstractSummaryZh: 不重建工具回复，而是建模推理和动作如何影响任务进展。通过动作判断和状态修订清理缺乏依据或过时的推理，在搜索、终端和软件任务中改善动作评价与智能体表现。
tags: LLM agents; Task state; Action effects
relevanceNote: World-model framing targets evolving task progress and agent state rather than a conventional external-environment simulator.
relevanceNoteZh: 使用世界模型框架描述任务进展与智能体状态变化，而非传统外部环境模拟。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: AGR-JEPA: Action-Grounded Residual Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Planning
abstractSummary: Models future representations as action-dependent changes to the current state. Recovering actions from those changes helps distinguish different action consequences and narrow the gap between prediction accuracy and planning success.
abstractSummaryZh: 把未来表示写成当前状态加动作相关变化，并从变化中恢复动作，以保留不同动作的后果差异，缩小预测精度与规划效果之间的差距。
tags: JEPA; Latent dynamics; Inverse dynamics; Planning
relevanceNote: Explicitly improves the control relevance of reconstruction-free world-model states.
relevanceNoteZh: 提升无重建世界模型表征对动作区分和下游规划的价值。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: AHA-WAM: Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
abstractSummary: A slower video model maintains reusable long-range predictive context while a faster action model responds to new observations. Horizon-offset training allows the two components to operate asynchronously.
abstractSummaryZh: 较慢的视频模型维护可复用的长期预测上下文，较快的动作模型根据最新观测响应；不同预测跨度的训练支持异步运行。
tags: world-action models; Asynchronous control; Robotics; Efficiency
relevanceNote: Separates world prediction and action execution rates in an embodied controller.
relevanceNoteZh: 在具身控制中分离世界预测与动作执行的时间频率。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
abstractSummary: AlayaWorld supports camera navigation and text-driven behaviors in continuously generated video worlds. It combines spatial memory, temporal context and motion conditioning, trained on annotated real-world and game data plus synthetic event supervision. Imperfect-history training and few-step distillation target stable long-horizon interaction.
tags: interactive worlds; action control; playable worlds; long horizon
relevanceNote: Explicit playable video world model with navigation and semantic actions.
relevanceNoteZh: 明确研究可游玩的交互式视频世界，支持导航与文本驱动动作。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling
abstractSummary: Separates agreement between a multimodal model's textual forecast and generated video from agreement with physical ground truth. Matched event and magnitude contracts diagnose discrepancies, and increasingly explicit conditioning fails to ensure quantitative repair. Downstream action screening improves push planning, while some additional supervision benefits remain unresolved.
abstractSummaryZh: 区分模型文本预测与生成视频之间的一致性，以及二者与真实物理结果的一致性。利用匹配的事件和幅度要求诊断差异，更明确的条件仍不能保证定量修复。动作筛选改善推物规划，但部分额外监督的任务收益尚未确定。
tags: Physical evaluation; Multimodal world models; Cross-modal alignment
relevanceNote: Direct audit of physical world models across prediction, generation, and downstream planning.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接审计物理世界模型在预测、生成和下游规划中的一致性。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL
abstractSummary: Learns a humanoid representation combining posture and world position. A one-step dynamics predictor and a goal-conditioned successor summary jointly guide policy improvement without requiring lengthy imagined rollouts.
abstractSummaryZh: 联合表示身体姿态、全局位置和朝向，以单步动力学预测器及目标条件后继表示指导策略改进，避免依赖长序列想象。
tags: JEPA; Humanoid control; Unsupervised RL; Latent dynamics
relevanceNote: Combines predictive physical transitions with longer-horizon behavioral representations.
relevanceNoteZh: 把物理转移预测与较长期行为表征结合，用于人形机器人控制。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series
abstractSummary: Represents delayed and persistent effects of future drivers as typed latent states. These states roll forward and route through a graph to target-specific predictors within a JEPA architecture. Controlled experiments on clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial time series isolate the contributions of latent dynamics and graph routing.
abstractSummaryZh: 将未来驱动因素的延迟和持续影响表示为带类型的潜在状态，沿时间展开后经图结构路由至各预测目标。临床、农业、环境和工业时间序列实验分析潜在动力学及图路由的贡献。
tags: JEPA; Time series; Structured dynamics
relevanceNote: Explicit structured latent dynamics for action-conditioned scientific and industrial systems.
relevanceNoteZh: 为动作条件的科学与工业系统建立结构化潜在动力学。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Beyond a Single Latent Space: A Dual-Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Planning
abstractSummary: Separates detailed execution dynamics from a coarser model using learned macro-actions. Weighted rollout supervision and top-down latent subgoals address accumulated prediction error in long-range visual control.
abstractSummaryZh: 用低层模型描述精细动作动态、高层宏动作模型描述长期转移，并通过加权多步预测监督及逐层子目标减少长期误差积累。
tags: Latent dynamics; Hierarchical planning; Long-horizon planning
relevanceNote: Learns two distinct world-model state spaces for execution and long-range planning.
relevanceNoteZh: 为局部执行与长期规划学习不同的世界模型状态空间。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Beyond the Next Step: Variable-Length Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
abstractSummary: Predicts future latent states directly from action sequences of varying lengths. An expanding-horizon curriculum trains extended dynamics, reducing reliance on repeated single-step prediction during planning.
abstractSummaryZh: 根据不同长度的动作序列直接预测未来潜状态，以逐步扩展跨度的课程训练长期动力学，减少规划时反复单步滚动带来的误差。
tags: Latent dynamics; JEPA; Long-horizon planning
relevanceNote: Changes world-model prediction from one-step transitions to flexible temporal horizons.
relevanceNoteZh: 将世界模型由单步转移预测扩展到可变长度动作序列。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Can Time-Series Foundation Models Serve as Simulators for Process Control?
abstractSummary: Tests frozen time-series foundation models as predictors of intervention effects and as simulators for choosing control inputs. Five synthetic process families provide paired action/no-change trajectories and executed control evaluations. Response timing, direction, amplitude, and tracking quality reveal failures hidden by ordinary forecast scores.
abstractSummaryZh: 在五类合成过程中检验冻结时间序列基础模型的干预效果预测和控制动作选择。成对动作与不变输入轨迹揭示响应方向、时机、幅度及跟踪误差，暴露普通预测评分未反映的问题。
tags: Time series; Process control; Simulation benchmark
relevanceNote: Direct evaluation of learned predictors used as action simulators for control.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接评测学习模型作为动作模拟器服务于过程控制的能力。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: CivWorldBench: Evaluating Language World Models in Structured Multi-Agent Sandbox Worlds
abstractSummary: Uses a multi-agent strategy engine to evaluate forecasting, hidden-state beliefs, and intervention effects at 1,900 decision points. Controlled observations and paired intervention rollouts reveal that strong forecasts do not reliably imply good belief inference or calibrated intervention magnitudes, while agent play tests decision usefulness.
abstractSummaryZh: 利用多智能体策略游戏构建1,900个决策点，评测关联预测、隐状态信念与干预效果。受控观测和成对干预轨迹表明，良好的预测表现不一定意味着可靠的信念推断或干预幅度估计。
tags: Benchmark; Language world models; Causal evaluation; Multi-agent
relevanceNote: Direct benchmark of language-world-model capabilities beyond observational prediction.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接评测语言世界模型的预测、隐状态推断和干预能力。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Closed-form Action Projection for Constrained World Model Planning in Robotics
abstractSummary: Derives admissible actions from the live controller state and projects planner outputs into that set without online optimization. World-model perception supplies geometric information for constrained, contact-rich manipulation.
abstractSummaryZh: 根据控制器实时状态解析地构造可行动作集合，并直接投影规划动作；结合世界模型中的几何观测，为接触密集操作施加力与速度限制。
tags: Robotics; Constrained planning; Contact dynamics; Safety
relevanceNote: Adds explicit execution constraints to learned policies and world-model planners.
relevanceNoteZh: 为学习策略与世界模型规划器增加显式执行约束。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Code Plans, Diffusion Renders: Open-Ended Generative World Modeling
abstractSummary: CoDeR constructs executable world rules and dynamics in code, then uses video generation to render observations. Five coordinated roles translate high-level concepts into structured behavior and visuals. The framework targets persistent memory, open-ended interaction, autonomous evolution and multi-agent worlds beyond the currently visible scene.
tags: executable world state; rule-based dynamics; multi-agent worlds; video rendering
relevanceNote: Explicit executable dynamics drive persistent generative worlds and their visual observations.
relevanceNoteZh: 以可执行规则与动力学维护持续世界，再生成对应视觉观测，直接研究显式状态世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
abstractSummary: Refines predictive representations using the observed outcomes of competing actions. The aim is to make latent goal distance rank candidate futures according to their usefulness for actual execution.
abstractSummaryZh: 利用候选动作真实执行后的结果调整预测表征，使潜空间中的目标距离更能反映候选未来的实际执行价值。
tags: JEPA; Planning; Representation learning; Robotics
relevanceNote: Aligns a world model's predictive geometry with downstream action selection.
relevanceNoteZh: 让世界模型的预测空间更贴合实际动作选择。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
abstractSummary: DA-WAM predicts a separate future latent state for each candidate driving trajectory and scores it for safety and utility. Joint embedding prediction grounds the latents in observed dynamics, while planning losses and safety-focused hard negatives sharpen distinctions between actions with different consequences.
tags: Autonomous driving; action-conditioned prediction; JEPA; trajectory scoring
relevanceNote: Models action-specific consequences in a latent world state for driving decisions.
relevanceNoteZh: 预测候选驾驶动作的不同后果，并用潜在世界状态辅助安全决策。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
abstractSummary: Learns action-conditioned hand and scene dynamics from depth and demonstrations, then transfers predictive features into a dexterous policy. Deployment retains the policy without explicit future generation.
abstractSummaryZh: 从深度、手部几何和演示中学习动作条件的手与场景变化，再把预测特征迁移到灵巧操作策略；部署时无需显式生成未来。
tags: Robotics; Dexterous manipulation; 3D dynamics; distillation
relevanceNote: A spatial world model supplies dynamics-aware representations for dexterous control.
relevanceNoteZh: 空间世界模型为灵巧操作策略提供动作相关的动态表征。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
abstractSummary: Predicts object motion and deformation in metric 3D before rendering future images. This separation supplies geometric structure to a lightweight causal video-generation process for hand-object interactions.
abstractSummaryZh: 先在度量三维空间中预测物体运动与形变，再渲染未来画面，为手物交互的视频生成提供几何约束。
tags: 3D dynamics; Dexterous manipulation; video world models; Physics
relevanceNote: An explicit 3D world model separates physical prediction from image synthesis.
relevanceNoteZh: 以显式三维世界模型将物理状态预测与图像生成分离。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Do Learned Models of Dynamical Systems Answer Interventional Questions? A Benchmark with Oracle References
abstractSummary: Evaluates twelve learned-dynamics methods on forecasts, new initial conditions, perturbations, clamp interventions, and causal graphs. Oracle models with known functional forms contextualize performance on ODEBench and sparse-coupling suites. Strong fits to observed trajectories often fail to transfer to interventions or reveal correct mechanisms.
abstractSummaryZh: 比较十二种动力学学习方法在预测、新初始条件、扰动、钳制干预和因果图上的表现。已知真实函数形式的参考模型用于衡量能力差距；对观测轨迹的良好拟合常无法迁移到干预或恢复正确机制。
tags: Scientific dynamics; Causal evaluation; Benchmark
relevanceNote: Mechanistic dynamics and intervention benchmark relevant to scientific world models, without centering an agent-planning architecture.
relevanceNoteZh: 与科学世界模型相关的机制动力学和干预基准，未以智能体规划为中心。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement
abstractSummary: Uses a slower global world-action planner alongside rapid updates guided by current wrist-camera observations. Both systems reuse a shared denoising process to preserve responsiveness during robot interaction.
abstractSummaryZh: 较慢的全局世界—动作规划器与基于最新腕部视角的快速更新协同工作，复用去噪过程以提高交互时的响应速度。
tags: world-action models; Robotics; Asynchronous control; Planning
relevanceNote: Connects broad world-model planning with frequent closed-loop action corrections.
relevanceNoteZh: 把较长时间跨度的世界模型规划与高频闭环修正结合。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Enfold: Folding World Model Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control
abstractSummary: Distills intermediate computations from a future-generating model into an encoder of present observations and instructions. The resulting predictive features support robot actions without repeatedly running the generator.
abstractSummaryZh: 将未来生成器的中间计算蒸馏到仅观察当前场景和指令的编码器，使机器人不必每一步运行完整生成器即可利用预测信息。
tags: Robotics; world-action models; distillation; Efficiency
relevanceNote: Investigates how generative world-model computation can support efficient embodied control.
relevanceNoteZh: 研究如何把生成式世界模型的预测计算转化为高效具身控制表征。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstractSummary: Alternates between acting and simulating an environment's reply within the same language-model policy. Joint reward optimization trains both roles, internalizing action–response dynamics without an external simulator during training. The resulting model also rehearses privately before real execution, with reported gains across tool-use benchmarks.
abstractSummaryZh: 同一语言模型策略在执行工具动作与扮演环境生成回复之间交替，并利用任务奖励联合优化两种角色。学到的动作—回复动力学也可用于真实执行前的内部演练，在多项工具使用基准上带来提升。
tags: Language world models; Agent training; Imagination
relevanceNote: Learns a language-agent world model through action-conditioned environment rehearsal.
relevanceNoteZh: 通过动作条件的环境演练学习语言智能体世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
abstractSummary: MIST separates whether a video world model executed an instructed change from whether it later remembered the result. Controlled delayed-reveal tests expose execution failures that conventional memory metrics can misclassify. M3-Agent iteratively rewrites instructions to improve execution, enabling a cleaner assessment of retained world changes.
tags: world-model evaluation; memory diagnosis; instruction execution; persistent state
relevanceNote: Directly evaluates the distinction between action execution and world-state memory.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接区分动作是否执行与世界状态是否被记住，改进视频世界模型的记忆评测。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
abstractSummary: Uses optical-flow video as an action interface alongside RGB in a shared diffusion model. It can generate flow for control or condition future-scene prediction on flow, with pretraining from videos lacking action labels.
abstractSummaryZh: 在共享扩散模型中并行建模 RGB 视频与光流视频，既能生成用于控制的光流，也能根据目标光流预测未来场景，并利用无动作标注视频预训练。
tags: world-action models; Optical flow; Robotics; Action representation
relevanceNote: Unifies action representation and conditional world prediction through optical flow.
relevanceNoteZh: 以光流统一动作表示与条件世界预测。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: ForceWAM: Decoupling Future and Response Learning from Demo and Play Data for Contact-Rich Manipulation
abstractSummary: Predicts future video and contact-force trajectories from task demonstrations. A separate inverse-dynamics model learns from demonstrations and play to convert those futures into actions using fresh force feedback.
abstractSummaryZh: 世界模型从任务演示中预测未来画面及六轴力矩轨迹，独立逆动力学模型再利用演示和自由探索经验，结合实时力反馈把未来预测转为动作。
tags: world-action models; Contact dynamics; Robotics; Inverse dynamics
relevanceNote: Jointly predicts visual and force dynamics for contact-rich control.
relevanceNoteZh: 联合预测视觉与力动态，用于接触密集机器人控制。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: FORECASTING SKILL ALONE DOES NOT CERTIFY INTERVENTION COMPETENCE IN WORLD MODELS
abstractSummary: Tests intervention prediction only after a world model demonstrates held-out forecast skill. In simulated epilepsy cohorts, models that clear the forecast gate fail to beat strong predictors that do not roll dynamics forward. Encoder swaps and ensemble analysis illustrate why forecasting competence alone does not certify intervention usefulness.
abstractSummaryZh: 先要求世界模型通过留出轨迹预测测试，再检验干预效果预测。在模拟癫痫系统中，通过预测门槛的展开模型仍未超过强非展开基线；编码器互换和集成分析揭示了预测与干预能力之间的差距。
tags: Causal evaluation; Scientific world models; Benchmark
relevanceNote: Direct empirical critique of using forecast skill as evidence that a world model can support interventions.

status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
abstractSummary: ForeWAM reuses predictive attention states from a single video-model pass instead of rendering future frames. Dynamics-oriented registers encourage this compact context to retain interaction information useful for action generation.
abstractSummaryZh: ForeWAM 复用一次视频模型计算得到的预测注意力状态，并用动力学寄存器保留交互信息，为轻量动作解码提供未来上下文。
tags: world-action models; Latent dynamics; Robotics; Efficiency
relevanceNote: Extracts latent world-model foresight for control without explicit video generation.
relevanceNoteZh: 无需显式生成未来视频，即可把潜空间世界模型预测用于控制。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Fork-Ready World Models: Training Distilled World Models to Be Branchable
abstractSummary: This study examines how shared noisy caches can correlate branches of imagined video rollouts and weaken best-of-k search. A fork-invariance objective with capped gradients aims to reduce that correlation while retaining prefix sensitivity and visual quality. The abstract explicitly notes limited training-run evidence and imperfect quality judges.
tags: branching rollouts; imagination search; video world models; distillation
relevanceNote: Studies whether video-world-model continuations are sufficiently independent and faithful for tree-structured imagination.
relevanceNoteZh: 研究视频世界模型的分支推演是否兼具独立性与条件忠实度，直接关系到树状想象和搜索。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation
abstractSummary: FracGen learns controllable fracture dynamics from simulated videos paired with dense physical fields. Joint prediction of imagery and physical signals, together with consistency losses, is intended to capture material-dependent stretching and tearing. A new benchmark evaluates fracture plausibility and visual fidelity without test-time simulation.
tags: fracture dynamics; physics-aware video; simulation supervision; materials
relevanceNote: Specialized learned physical video dynamics relevant to world simulation, rather than a general interactive world model.
relevanceNoteZh: 研究特定材料的断裂视频动力学，与物理世界模拟密切相关，但不是通用交互式世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
abstractSummary: Trace2Env constructs reusable schemas, evidence, and behavioral knowledge from historical interaction traces when the original environment is unavailable. A world-model agent consults this resource and persistent state to infer observations and lasting action effects. Evaluations across nine environments assess next-observation fidelity and multi-turn consistency.
abstractSummaryZh: Trace2Env从历史交互轨迹整理环境模式、证据和行为知识，供世界模型智能体结合持久状态推断观测及动作的长期影响。在九种环境中评测下一观测保真度和多轮交互一致性。
tags: Language world models; Environment reconstruction; Stateful simulation
relevanceNote: Builds agentic language simulators that preserve state transitions across interaction turns.
relevanceNoteZh: 从交互记录构建能跨轮保持状态转移的语言环境模拟器。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Future Representation Distillation for World Action Models
abstractSummary: DreamFree transfers a frozen video generator's predictive representations into an encoder of present observations. An action module uses those features for real-time control and learning from cross-embodiment video demonstrations.
abstractSummaryZh: DreamFree 把冻结视频生成器的预测表征迁移到当前观测编码器，供动作模块进行实时控制，并利用跨形态视频演示学习任务。
tags: world-action models; distillation; Robotics; Efficiency
relevanceNote: Distills predictive world-model knowledge into deployable control representations.
relevanceNoteZh: 将世界模型的预测知识蒸馏为可高效部署的控制表征。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: GameDirector: Decoupling Gameplay Logic from Rendering for Player-Configurable Game World Models
abstractSummary: GameDirector separates configurable gameplay rules from video rendering. An agent interprets observations, updates game state, controls non-player characters and translates rule-respecting outcomes into generation prompts. Experiments examine state tracking, rule compliance and character behavior across three games.
tags: game world models; explicit state; rule execution; NPC control
relevanceNote: Maintains explicit game state and rules that govern an interactive generative environment.
relevanceNoteZh: 以显式游戏状态和规则约束生成环境，支持闭环交互与角色行为控制。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: GauMem: Learning What to Keep in a Fixed-Budget Gaussian Memory for World Models
abstractSummary: GauMem maintains a bounded scene memory using 3D Gaussians and a learned write policy. It compares incoming views with rendered memory, merges consistent evidence and jointly ranks insertion and eviction candidates. Training on delayed revisits is intended to preserve scene recall under a hard storage budget.
tags: scene memory; 3D Gaussians; long horizon; video world models
relevanceNote: A learned bounded spatial memory directly supports persistent video world simulation.
relevanceNoteZh: 为视频世界模型学习容量受限的三维场景记忆，重点解决长时回访和记忆取舍。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: GEMOT: Towards Mechanistic World Models For Biology
abstractSummary: Introduces an agentic framework that jointly discovers latent states and explicit governing mechanisms for biological systems. Hypotheses are recorded separately from numerical evaluation for auditable scoring. Across eighteen published problems, constructed models match or exceed reference fit and parsimony, with generalization evaluated where held-out data exist.
abstractSummaryZh: 提出联合发现潜在状态与显式支配机制的智能体框架，将假设记录与数值评估分离以保证评分可审计。在十八项已发表生物问题中，构建模型的拟合与简约性达到或超过参考模型，并在存在留出数据时检验泛化。
tags: Scientific world models; Biology; Mechanistic discovery
relevanceNote: Directly builds explicit mechanistic world models that explain observations and predict beyond training measurements.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接构建可解释观测并预测未见情形的显式生物机制世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: GeoSCope: Grounded, Stable and Controllable Driving World Models
abstractSummary: GeoSCope grounds generative driving simulations in a static 3D route map reconstructed from one monocular recording. Rendering that map at each requested viewpoint conditions subsequent video, limiting scene drift while retaining dynamic objects. Experiments test long-horizon stability, counterfactual trajectories and transfer between driving datasets.
tags: driving simulation; geometric grounding; Counterfactual rollouts; 3D world state
relevanceNote: Grounds controlled driving rollouts in a persistent real-world scene state.
relevanceNoteZh: 以真实路线的持久三维状态约束驾驶模拟，支持长期稳定的反事实轨迹推演。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
abstractSummary: Benchmarks text-based simulation with 1,632 tasks across five domains and nineteen skills. Models predict action-induced environment responses using interaction history, with execution-derived references and mixed deterministic/semantic checks. Evaluation finds major weaknesses when an action's effects must propagate across dependent objects.
abstractSummaryZh: 以五个领域、十九类技能中的1,632项任务评测文本世界模型。模型依据交互历史预测动作引发的环境回复，并与真实执行参考比较。动作效果需要传播到依赖对象时，性能出现明显下降。
tags: Benchmark; Language world models; State transitions
relevanceNote: Direct evaluation of text-based action-conditioned environment simulation.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接评测文本形式的动作条件环境模拟。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models
abstractSummary: GROME separates historical evidence into static geometry and changing entity states. It retrieves spatially aligned static observations and recent dynamic information, then injects them through a frozen video generator’s conditioning interfaces. Reported long-horizon tests assess scene persistence, entity continuity and controllable continuation.
tags: scene memory; dynamic objects; training free; long horizon
relevanceNote: Factorized static and dynamic memory supports a persistent evolving visual world.
relevanceNoteZh: 分别维护静态场景和动态实体记忆，支持持续演化世界的长时一致性。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Grounded World Model: Latent Planning with Language Goals
abstractSummary: Predicts action-conditioned futures inside a pretrained video-language representation space. Language-to-future similarity scores candidate action plans, enabling language-goal control without language-labeled world-model training data.
abstractSummaryZh: 在预训练视频—语言表征空间中预测动作后果，用未来状态与语言目标的相似度评估候选计划，世界模型训练无需语言标注。
tags: Language goals; Latent dynamics; Robotics; Planning
relevanceNote: Uses a predictive world model to plan directly from natural-language goals.
relevanceNoteZh: 利用预测世界模型直接根据自然语言目标进行规划。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
abstractSummary: Learns a hierarchy of predictive latent spaces operating at progressively longer horizons. Higher-level plans become subgoals for lower-level controllers, improving long-range visual navigation and manipulation.
abstractSummaryZh: 学习多层预测潜空间，各层预测跨度逐渐增加；高层计划成为低层控制器的子目标，用于长期导航和操作。
tags: JEPA; Hierarchical planning; Latent dynamics; Robotics
relevanceNote: Builds multilevel world models for planning across time scales.
relevanceNoteZh: 构建跨时间尺度的分层世界模型，实现长期视觉规划。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Hamiltonian JEPA: Action-Conditioned World Models with an Inherited Isotropic Control State
abstractSummary: Separates visual perception from a structured control state. Port-Hamiltonian dynamics and an action-consistency objective make latent transitions more useful for pixel-based planning.
abstractSummaryZh: 将视觉感知表示与控制状态分离，利用端口哈密顿动力学和动作一致性目标，让潜状态转移更适合基于图像的规划。
tags: JEPA; Latent dynamics; Physics; Planning
relevanceNote: Explicit action-conditioned world model with physically structured latent dynamics.
relevanceNoteZh: 通过物理结构化潜动力学构建可用于控制的动作条件世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Hamiltonian JEPA: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models
abstractSummary: Introduces an action-conditioned Hamiltonian predictor with symplectic integration to prevent latent-space contraction during long rollouts. Visual pendulum experiments test prediction, time reversal and changes in integration resolution.
abstractSummaryZh: 使用动作条件哈密顿预测器和辛积分，抑制长序列预测中的潜空间收缩，并在视觉摆任务中检验预测、时间反演和不同积分精度。
tags: JEPA; Physics; Latent dynamics; Long-horizon prediction
relevanceNote: Addresses stability and physical structure of learned latent world dynamics.
relevanceNoteZh: 研究潜空间世界动力学的长期稳定性与物理结构。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: HiLo-WAM: Decoupling Long-Horizon Task Evolution and Local Dynamics in World Action Models
abstractSummary: Combines a coarse stream for long-term task progress with a dense stream for immediate robot-object interactions. Structured communication between them guides actions and avoids unnecessary prediction computation.
abstractSummaryZh: 将描述长期任务进展的粗粒度分支与描述即时机器人—物体交互的密集分支结合，通过跨分支信息交互生成动作并减少预测开销。
tags: world-action models; Long-horizon planning; Robotics; Multi-scale dynamics
relevanceNote: Models distinct temporal scales of environmental change for robot actions.
relevanceNoteZh: 为机器人动作显式建模长期任务变化与短期局部动态。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
abstractSummary: HLA-WM addresses forgetting in recurrent linear-attention world models without further training. It caches compact chunk-transition summaries, retrieves earlier chunks using camera geometry and recomposes a query-specific state. The evaluations measure long-range revisit consistency, camera control and memory efficiency.
tags: linear attention; memory retrieval; training free; long horizon
relevanceNote: Direct method for persistent memory in long-horizon video world models.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接改进长时视频世界模型的持续记忆与远期场景回忆。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model
abstractSummary: Holo-World generates video from a single image under joint camera, object and optional weather controls. A unified dataset supplies control supervision, while factorized adapters separate scene preservation from weather-dependent appearance changes. Decomposed guidance aims to retain controlled structure while rendering the requested environmental state.
tags: controllable worlds; camera control; object motion; weather state
relevanceNote: Models controlled scene evolution across camera, object and environmental-state changes.
relevanceNoteZh: 联合控制相机、物体与天气状态，研究受控场景演化的视频世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
abstractSummary: Honeycomb stores persistent scene features in six fixed-size spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer updates this representation from each new video chunk, while a reader supplies memory to later generation. Its reported evaluations emphasize consistent revisits without storage growing with rollout length.
tags: video world models; scene memory; long horizon; 3D consistency
relevanceNote: Explicit persistent-memory video world model for long-horizon visual simulation.
relevanceNoteZh: 以固定容量场景记忆维持长时视频生成与回访一致性，属于直接的视频世界模型研究。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: How To Train Your World Model: Fine-tuning vs RAG for LM-based World Modeling
abstractSummary: Compares fine-tuned and retrieval-based language world models across five embodied, web, and social environments. Fine-tuning wins more often, while retrieval is more data-efficient. Analysis of retrieved transitions motivates hierarchical retrieval and a hybrid system combining learned dynamics with maintained experience memory.
abstractSummaryZh: 在五类具身、网页和社交环境中比较微调与检索增强的语言世界模型。微调总体更强，检索则更节省数据。研究分析检索转移样本的缺陷，并提出结合参数化动力学与经验记忆的混合方案。
tags: Language world models; Retrieval; Agent planning
relevanceNote: Directly compares ways to construct text-based models of environment transitions.
relevanceNoteZh: 直接比较文本环境状态转移模型的构建方法。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: How World Models Misjudge Actions: A Case Study of LeWM
abstractSummary: Intervenes on states, commands, scores and action aggregation to diagnose why predicted action rankings diverge from actual execution. Experiments reveal both missed consequential differences and sensitivity to irrelevant command variations.
abstractSummaryZh: 通过干预物理状态、命令、评分与动作聚合，分析预测排序为何偏离真实执行，揭示模型忽略关键差异或过度响应无关差异的问题。
tags: world-model evaluation; Planning; Action sensitivity; Latent dynamics
relevanceNote: Diagnoses whether a world model distinguishes action differences that matter for execution.
relevanceNoteZh: 诊断世界模型能否区分对实际执行有意义的动作差异。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Human-in-the-World-Model for Scalable Robot Post-Training
abstractSummary: Collects human corrections inside an action-conditioned simulator built from a world model. Cached states and branching allow repeated corrective demonstrations, which are combined with real data to improve physical robot policies.
abstractSummaryZh: 让策略在世界模型生成的观测中闭环运行，由人类纠正可能失败的执行；缓存、回滚和分支支持重复收集修正轨迹，再与真实演示联合训练。
tags: Robotics; World-model simulation; Human feedback; Policy improvement
relevanceNote: Uses learned world simulation as an environment for corrective policy training.
relevanceNoteZh: 用学习到的世界模拟器收集纠正反馈，改进真实机器人策略。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: HumanWorld: From Explorable to Human-centric Interactive World Model
abstractSummary: HumanWorld separates latent interaction dynamics from video rendering. Human motion and camera paths share a 3D coordinate system; a learned interaction module predicts resulting object and scene changes, which condition a pretrained generator. The method supports navigation, human action control and action-driven scene evolution.
tags: human interaction; action-conditioned dynamics; 3D control; video world models
relevanceNote: Models how controlled human actions change persistent objects and scenes before rendering observations.
relevanceNoteZh: 先预测受控人物动作如何改变物体和场景，再生成视觉观测，属于直接的交互动力学世界模型。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: I Act Therefore I Am: When Is JEPA's Action-Conditioning Enough to Learn Causal Mechanisms?
abstractSummary: Derives conditions under which action-conditioned predictive representations recover latent causal states. The objective combines transition likelihood with preservation of state information, requiring enough action-induced variation. An action-modulated JEPA instantiation is evaluated on synthetic systems and visual transfer to unseen mechanisms.
abstractSummaryZh: 推导动作条件预测表示恢复潜在因果状态的条件，目标结合转移似然与状态信息保留，并要求足够的动作诱导变化。动作调制JEPA在合成系统和未见转移机制的视觉迁移任务上进行验证。
tags: JEPA; Causal representation; Identifiability
relevanceNote: Theoretical and empirical study of causal-state recovery in action-conditioned world modeling.
relevanceNoteZh: 研究动作条件世界模型何时能够恢复真实潜在因果状态。
status: ICLR 2027 submission listed by acceptodds; primary verification pending

title: Imagine Before You Call: Factored World Models for Tool-Using Agents
abstractSummary: Introduces FOLD, which predicts tool-call consequences through factored one-step latent dynamics. Four state blocks distinguish action responsiveness and reward relevance. Jointly learned transitions, rewards, and values support training and test-time look-ahead, with an identifiability analysis and evaluations on embodied and tool-use benchmarks.
abstractSummaryZh: FOLD通过分解的一步潜在动力学预测工具调用后果，将状态按动作响应性和奖励相关性划分为四块。联合学习转移、奖励和价值，以支持训练及测试时前瞻，并给出可辨识性分析。
tags: Tool use; Latent dynamics; Agent planning
relevanceNote: Explicitly models how candidate tool calls change the environment before execution.
relevanceNoteZh: 显式预测候选工具调用在执行前会如何改变环境。
status: ICLR 2027 submission listed by acceptodds; primary verification pending

title: Inference Time Policy Optimization for Offline RL with Differentiable World Models
abstractSummary: Adapts a pretrained offline policy during deployment by differentiating through imagined trajectories. Experiments examine control improvements and the computational cost of online policy updates.
abstractSummaryZh: 在部署阶段通过可微世界模型中的想象轨迹更新离线策略，并分析控制收益与在线优化计算开销之间的权衡。
tags: Model-based RL; Offline RL; Differentiable planning
relevanceNote: Uses learned dynamics and imagined rollouts to optimize decisions at inference time.
relevanceNoteZh: 利用学习到的环境动力学和想象轨迹，在推理时优化策略。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: JEPA-DIT: FROM-SCRATCH PREDICTIVE WORLD-MODEL PRETRAINING FOR MANIPULATION
abstractSummary: Pretrains a diffusion transformer directly in predictive latent space and combines it with a complementary reconstruction stream. The design is evaluated for manipulation and robustness to appearance changes.
abstractSummaryZh: 直接在 JEPA 预测潜空间中从头预训练扩散 Transformer，并结合互补的重建分支，评估操作能力及对外观变化的稳健性。
tags: JEPA; world-action models; Diffusion; Robotics
relevanceNote: Develops predictive latent world-action pretraining for robotic manipulation.
relevanceNoteZh: 面向机器人操作研究预测潜空间中的世界—动作模型预训练。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: Joint Modeling of Visual and Physical Fields for Consistent Video Generation
abstractSummary: VideoPF jointly models video and physical signals such as velocity, acceleration and depth. A physics-aware data pipeline, gated diffusion-transformer components and consistency refinement address noisy supervision and implausible motion. The reported experiments examine whether structured physical representations improve generated dynamics.
tags: physical fields; physics-aware video; motion consistency; video diffusion
relevanceNote: Structured physical-state generation supports world-simulation fidelity but does not establish an interactive action-state model.
relevanceNoteZh: 用结构化物理场提升视觉模拟可信度，但尚未建立完整的交互式动作状态模型。
status: ICLR 2027 submission listed by acceptodds; primary verification pending

title: Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization
abstractSummary: Trains joint state-action generators through dynamics-constrained trajectory optimization. At deployment, the model generates candidate plans and scores them with learned dynamics rather than iteratively optimizing every trajectory.
abstractSummaryZh: 通过带动力学约束的轨迹优化训练联合状态—动作生成器；部署时生成候选计划并用世界模型评分，避免反复迭代优化。
tags: world-action models; Planning; Differentiable optimization; Control
relevanceNote: Directly couples predictive world dynamics with task-aware trajectory generation.
relevanceNoteZh: 将预测世界动力学与任务感知的状态—动作轨迹生成直接结合。
status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission

title: LaFree World Model: Label-Free Pretraining for Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models
abstractSummary: Infers discrete latent actions from consecutive observations to pretrain a JEPA dynamics model without action annotations. A small labeled subset then connects the learned action interface to real control inputs for planning.
abstractSummaryZh: 从相邻观测中推断离散潜动作，无需动作标注即可预训练 JEPA 动力学模型，再用少量标注数据连接真实控制输入并进行规划。
tags: JEPA; Latent actions; Self-supervised learning; Planning
relevanceNote: Learns action-conditioned world dynamics from unlabeled observation sequences.
relevanceNoteZh: 从无动作标注的观测序列学习动作条件世界动力学。

title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
abstractSummary: Uses language to describe actions and visual transitions across heterogeneous datasets, allowing one latent predictor to learn from robots, simulation and general media. The resulting model supports planning and policy initialization.
abstractSummaryZh: 用语言描述动作与视觉变化，让统一潜状态预测器联合学习机器人、仿真及通用图像视频数据，并用于规划和策略初始化。
tags: JEPA; Language actions; Latent dynamics; Multi-domain learning
relevanceNote: Unifies heterogeneous action interfaces for scalable latent world-model training.
relevanceNoteZh: 以语言统一不同数据源的动作接口，扩展潜空间世界模型训练。
status: ICLR 2027 submission listed by acceptodds; primary verification pending

title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
abstractSummary: LSM-World stores scene information directly in diffusion latents, lifting tokens into a persistent 3D cache with depth and retrieving them through latent-space view warping. Avoiding repeated pixel rendering and encoding reduces overhead while the reported experiments test geometric, photometric and closed-loop revisit consistency.
tags: latent world models; scene memory; 3D consistency; efficient inference
relevanceNote: Explicit latent-space world state enables consistent camera-controlled future video.
relevanceNoteZh: 在潜在空间维护三维世界状态，支持相机控制下的一致未来视频生成。
status: ICLR 2027 submission listed by acceptodds; primary verification pending

title: Lazy Belief Expansion: Deciding What to Observe for World-Model Planning
abstractSummary: Adds a controller that decides when to read evidence, interact to obtain it, or commit a compact belief to a world-model planner. A training-free web-agent implementation reduces the evidence and tokens used in successful tasks while preserving or modestly improving success over the base planner.
abstractSummaryZh: 控制器选择读取已有证据、通过交互获取缺失信息，或将紧凑信念提交给规划器。无需训练的网页实例减少了成功任务中的证据与词元用量，同时保持或小幅提升原规划器的成功率。
tags: Belief states; Web agents; Planning efficiency
relevanceNote: Explicitly couples selective state evidence with prediction and action in a world-model planner.
relevanceNoteZh: 在世界模型规划中联合决定读取哪些状态证据以及如何行动。

title: Learning a Spatial Memory Codec for Video World Model
abstractSummary: This method compresses video history into learned memory entries paired with pose-and-time landmarks. A hierarchical reader first finds relevant landmarks and then retrieves their entries for generation. The reported tests include changing viewpoints, U-turns and retrieval from nearly two hours of observations.
tags: scene memory; learned compression; Retrieval; long horizon
relevanceNote: A spatial memory codec preserves earlier world observations for future visual simulation.
relevanceNoteZh: 通过可学习空间记忆压缩与检索，为未来视觉模拟保留早期世界观测。
